messages:
Anna L.: Heads-up — thinking about SLO-driven routing for customer tiers. Proposal: route by latency SLOs per tier (gold: 50ms p95, silver: 200ms p95, bronze: 500ms p95), and circuit-breaker that triggers fallback to smaller model variant or different region when p95 exceeds threshold for N consecutive windows. Thoughts?
Mike C.: +1, need quotas integration too — can't let fallback burn through reserved capacity.
Jess R.: Important: console needs to show active routing policy and recent triggers. UX: one-click disable fallback during incidents.
Kai W.: Agree. Also need model-variant compatibility matrix in policy: e.g., primary: redwood-rlhf-13b, fallback: redwood-quant8-7b, last-resort: hosted-fast-3b.
Sam T.: How do we detect 'available'? use 500ms tail + error rate >1%? propose circuit breaker triggers when p95 > SLO*1.5 OR error_rate > 0.5% for 3 windows.
Anna L.: Here's pseudo-config:
```
routing_policy {
  tier: GOLD
  slo_p95_ms: 50
  cb_windows: 3
  cb_condition: "p95 > slo*1.5 || errors > 0.005"
  fallback_chain: ["redwood-rlhf-13b-stable","redwood-quant8-7b-compat","fast-3b-hosted"]
}
```
Mike C.: We should add cost cap per fallback invocation to protect billing for hosted fallbacks.
Jess R.: Console telemetry: per-route p95, fallback count, cost delta, last_cb_trigger. Add inline graph and quick filter by customer.
product-lead: Note: enterprise customers will want opt-out of automatic fallback. Make flag per-customer + audit logs.
sre-bot: Alert: last 5m p95 for region us-west on redwood-rlhf-13b = 210ms (SLO 50ms) — circuit breaker fired for customers in silver tier at 1713005400
deploy-bot: Canary deploy ongoing for routing engine v2.1. Rolling back if cb triggers >5 within 10m.
Kai W.: Edge-case: what if KV cache warmup amplifies initial p95 — maybe require CB only after cache_warmup_window (30s) or after N requests.
Sam T.: Also expose CLI/API to simulate fallback path for QA.
Anna L.: Next action: prototyping config + console mockups. Jess + Mike take telemetry and cost controls. Kai + Sam implement CB logic and fallback executor. Product to draft opt-out policy. I'll spin up an RFC draft in docs repo.
Jess R.: Ack. I'll mock a dashboard panel and add notes for rollout UX (canary, manual override, grace window).
Mike C.: I'll add quota checks so fallbacks decrement reserved slots vs hosted bucket.
Anna L.: Thanks — will sync Thursday 10am. :calendar:
